description: This is a PHP unit test class file for testing the TimesheetDao component in the OrangeHRM Time plugin. It contains test cases for creating, retrieving, and validating timesheets, timesheet items, and related entities within the HR management system.

classes.name: TimesheetDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the TimesheetDao class methods related to timesheet CRUD operations, logs, reports, and validations in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment, initializes the TimesheetDao object, and populates test fixtures before each test case.

methods.name: testAddTimesheet
methods.description: Test case for creating a new Timesheet object, saving it, and verifying its properties.

methods.name: testDuplicateTimesheet
methods.description: Checks if the system correctly identifies duplicate timesheets based on start date.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetActionLogs
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of timesheet action logs.

methods.name: testAddTimesheetActionLog
methods.description: Tests adding a new TimesheetActionLog and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testGetMyTimesheets
methods.description: Tests retrieving timesheets for a specific employee within date range.

methods.name: testIsDuplicateTimesheetItem
methods.description: Checks for duplicate timesheet items based on project, activity, and timesheet IDs.

methods.name: testAddTimesheetItem
methods.description: Tests creation of a new TimesheetItem with associated project, activity, employee, and timesheet.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetItemById
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a timesheet item by its timesheet ID and item ID.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetById
methods.description: Checks retrieval of a timesheet by its ID and verifies its properties.

methods.name: testSaveAndUpdateTimesheetItemsExceptionCase
methods.description: Verifies that saving timesheet items throws a LogicException when project activity does not belong to the project.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeTimesheetList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of employee timesheets filtered by employee numbers and statuses.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeTimesheetListCount
methods.description: Verifies counting of employee timesheets filtered by specific criteria.

methods.name: testGetLatestTimesheet
methods.description: Tests fetching the latest timesheet for an employee with date range filtering.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetItemsForEmployeeReportAndTotalHours
methods.description: Validates retrieval of timesheet items for employee reports and total hours with various filters.

methods.name: testGetTimesheetItemsCountForEmployeeReport
methods.description: Checks counting of timesheet items for employee reports based on filters.

methods.name: testTimesheetAvailability
methods.description: Verifies the retrieval of a timesheet item by project, timesheet, activity, and date, expecting null if not present.
